items.title: George "Kid Sheik" Colar Interview, 1958-07-20
items.q: Mark beats the trumpet and every year, the kuzit, the kuzit.

ctx.x: Was there anybody in particular who taught you to play your instrument, trumpet? Not right off the reel.

I just flew around with the horn and used to put a kuzit, one of the kuzit, and just blowed like I was playing the trumpet. Mark beats the trumpet and every year, the kuzit, the kuzit. And Faisal and I got around Chris and them. He told me to come to his house and taught me how to try to blow it. Didn't have much time to waste with me. Every time I blew that wood we go, I'd start to drink. That was the most of the thing, was drinking. In fact, I got a little more experience from Wooden Joe because I used to go by…
But before we go on, I'm sure if I would ask for Mr. Kuller somewhere among the musicians, nobody would know your name. Your name actually among musicians is Sheik, isn't it?
